assessments.summary: Ebola cases are peaking in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with sustained high-level transmission, causing 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of November 2026.
Dengue cases in the US are rising sharply, with 57 reported cases per week in the latest week, up 533% from eight months ago.
Influenza is peaking globally with 9% test positivity and 8,415 US hospital admissions in the latest week, up 76% from the previous month.
Measles cases in the US are rising rapidly, with 223 reported cases per week, up 232% from eight months ago.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising sharply, with 98 reported cases per week, up 1,762% from eight months ago.
Malaria cases in the US are rising slightly, with 38 reported cases per week, up 59% from eight months ago.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising, with 374 reported cases per week, up 48% from eight months ago.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are at baseline with 280 reported cases per week, slightly down from the previous eight months.
Marburg virus disease activity is falling, with Wikipedia readership at the 64th percentile of the past year.
Mpox cases in the US are rising, with 41 reported per week (up 47% from 8 months ago), but activity remains baseline.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are up 10% monthly, but activity remains baseline.
Cholera news coverage is increasing, with 18 English articles per day (up 70% from 4 weeks ago).
Norovirus news coverage is increasing, with 6 English articles per day (up 40% from 4 weeks ago).
Global RSV test positivity is up 42% monthly, with US hospital admissions rising 47% monthly.
Avian influenza (bird flu) Wikipedia readership is at the 42nd percentile of the past year.
